items.label: Qualcomm Q3 FY2026 (07-29-2026)
items.signal_prefix: CALL-ONLY: THE FULL DATA-CENTER PLAN, WITH DATES. Four product lines

set.signal: CALL-ONLY: THE FULL DATA-CENTER PLAN, WITH DATES. Four product lines phased over two years - CONNECTIVITY in fiscal 2026, CUSTOM SILICON and AI ACCELERATORS in fiscal 2027, SERVER-CLASS CPUs in fiscal 2028. The two near-term CUSTOM SILICON WINS are REVENUE-GENERATING IN THE DECEMBER QUARTER: 'we have begun wafer production', 'we do have POs from these engagements', and both customers are 'GLOBAL SCALE HYPERSCALERS' in 'the first phase of strategic multi-year customer relationships that we expect to expand over time'. On the accelerator: Qualcomm 'completed the TAPE-OUT of HBC GEN 1' - High Bandwidth Compute, which 'integrat[es] compute directly with high-density memory, improving performance per watt, memory efficiency, and total cost of ownership' - with silicon performance demonstrations 'in the coming quarters' ahead of the FIRST HBC SOLUTION LAUNCH IN MID-2027. Management says it is 'in active conversations with NEARLY EVERY LEADING DATA CENTER PLAYER' across HBC-based accelerators, server connectivity and CPUs, while acknowledging customers 'want to see silicon' before committing. Targets: data-center revenue $5B in FY2027 and $15B in FY2029 (the path to $15B being 'multi-product, multi-generation on the custom ASIC, plus the ramp of the accelerator and the CPU'); total NON-HANDSET revenue $40B by FY2029, up from the prior $22B target; non-handset >50% of QCT revenue in FY2027 and ~2/3 by FY2029, with non-handset growth accelerating from 24% in FY2026 to GREATER THAN 60% in FY2027 - enough to 'replace total Apple product revenues in 2026'. Margin caveat (CFO Akash Palkhiwala): because the first data-center revenue is mostly from custom chip engagements, it is expected to be 'significantly lower than our ongoing kind of baseline gross margin percentage' and will be 'a drag of 1.5%-2% on the weighted average gross margin for QCT'.

items.reason: The margin-caveat quote was not verbatim ('ongoing baseline gross margin', '1.5-2 POINT DRAG'); replaced with the CFO's exact words and attribution. Everything else in the entry checks out against the speaker-labelled copy.
items.evidence: we do expect that to be significantly lower than our ongoing kind of baseline gross margin percentage, that will be a drag of 1.5%-2% on the weighted average gross margin for QCT.

set.signal: FQ3 2026 (ended 06-28-2026): revenues $9.9B — at the HIGH END of guidance 'despite a challenging MEMORY AND SUPPLY environment' — with GAAP EPS $1.87 and non-GAAP EPS $2.21. HANDSET REVENUE $5,086M, DOWN 20% YoY. Diversification offset: combined QCT AUTOMOTIVE AND IoT revenues +28% YoY, with automotive posting its 23RD CONSECUTIVE QUARTER of double-digit growth. COST PASS-THROUGH CONFIRMED: 'the semiconductor industry is experiencing a BROAD-BASED INCREASE IN INPUT COSTS across wafer fabrication, assembly, test, advanced packaging, MEMORY and other materials. We are taking concrete actions to reflect the higher input costs in OUR PRODUCT PRICING' — expected to benefit gross margins over time. FQ4 guide: revenues $9.7-10.5B (QCT $8.4-9.0B, QTL $1.2-1.4B).
